title: Virtual Care Price List and Prepayment Terms by Visit Type
content:
Each Virtual Care visit type carries a self-pay price in US dollars, a setting for whether payment is collected when the encounter is requested, a setting for whether the encounter is billed to insurance for insured patients, a copay class, a price-display setting and a refund period for a prepayment that becomes refundable. The figures below cover all six visit types.

## Terms used in this price list

- **Self-pay price** — the price of the encounter for a patient whose Patient Financial Account is a Self-Pay Account, in US dollars.
- **Prepayment at request** — whether payment is collected when the encounter is requested (yes or no).
- **Billed to insurance** — whether the encounter is billed to insurance for insured patients (yes or no).
- **Copay class** — which insurance copay applies to an insured patient. The class is one of three values: none, primary or specialist.
- **Price shown before submission** — whether the self-pay price is shown to the patient before the request is submitted (yes or no).
- **Prepayment refund period** — the number of business days within which a prepayment that becomes refundable is refunded.

## Schedule

| Visit type | Self-pay price | Prepayment at request | Billed to insurance | Copay class | Price shown before submission | Prepayment refund period |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Portal E-Visit | $35.00 | Yes | Yes | primary | Yes | 5 business days |
| Audio-Only Phone Visit | $65.00 | No | Yes | primary | Yes | 5 business days |
| Primary Care Video Visit | $89.00 | No | Yes | primary | Yes | 5 business days |
| Behavioral Health Video Visit | $129.00 | No | Yes | specialist | Yes | 5 business days |
| Specialty Video Follow-Up | $119.00 | No | Yes | specialist | Yes | 5 business days |
| On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care | $79.00 | Yes | Yes | primary | Yes | 5 business days |

## Reading the schedule by column

- **Prepayment at request.** Two visit types collect payment when the encounter is requested: the Portal E-Visit and On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care. The Audio-Only Phone Visit, Primary Care Video Visit, Behavioral Health Video Visit and Specialty Video Follow-Up do not.
- **Copay class.** The Behavioral Health Video Visit and the Specialty Video Follow-Up carry the specialist copay class; the other four visit types carry the primary copay class. No Virtual Care visit type carries the class none.
- **Billed to insurance, price shown, refund period.** These three settings are the same on every visit type: every encounter type is billed to insurance for insured patients, every self-pay price is shown before submission, and every refundable prepayment is refunded within 5 business days.

## Points of reference

**What is the highest and the lowest self-pay price in Virtual Care?** The Behavioral Health Video Visit carries the highest self-pay price, $129.00; the Portal E-Visit carries the lowest, $35.00.

**By how much does the Specialty Video Follow-Up price differ from the Primary Care Video Visit price?** The Specialty Video Follow-Up price of $119.00 exceeds the Primary Care Video Visit price of $89.00 by $30.00.
